about: Newquay Activity Centre is a surf school and activity centre on Fore Street in central Newquay, running lessons since 1996. Guests change at the centre and walk about five minutes to the beach, which is usually Great Western. It also runs coasteering, paddleboarding, kayaking and group adventure days.
offers: Stag, hen, school and corporate groups
where: 60 Fore Street, Newquay TR7 1LW; lessons mainly on Great Western Beach, with Towan and Fistral nearby
goodToKnow: Wetsuit, rash vest and foam board included; hoods, gloves and boots in winter
Heated changing rooms, lockers and hot showers
Bring swimwear, a towel and sun cream; you should be able to swim 50 metres
AALA licensed, with ISA-qualified, lifeguard-trained instructors
season: Banner says the centre is closed until the 2027 season
gaps: Says 'closed until the 2027 season' (probably a winter closure), so re-check in spring. Only the lessons page was fetched.
